Name: Alien Jelly
Overview:
Alien Jelly is a 3D puzzle game. It uses a mechanic of flipping the world around to solve puzzles and get your avatars to the exit point. The player controls multiple Alien Jelly characters that come in a variety of four colors, which each play a roll in some of the puzzles. The game also supports up to 4 players local co-op.

The additional puzzle mechanics include portals, pushing crates, stacking Alien Jellies to create stairways, color changing blocks that only allows a character of the same color to be on it, hologram blocks that can be turned on and off to create pathways. The game includes hazard elements such as spike pits, crushing blocks, lasers and robots that shoot lasers.

The game sports a level editor crafted for consoles. All the levels in the game were built in the same editor that ships with the game. The players can also share these levels with friends through the Xbox Live Gold service.
